mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admins (store_id, position_id, authority_id, last_name, first_name, email, phone_number, password) VALUES (#{storeId},#{positionId},#{authorityId},#{lastName},#{firstName},#{email},#{phoneNumber},#{password})
mapper.select:
SELECT admins.id, admins.last_name, admins.first_name, stores.store_name, admin_positions.position_name, admin_authorities.authority_name FROM admins
INNER JOIN stores ON admins.store_id = stores.id
INNER JOIN admin_positions ON admins.position_id = admin_positions.id
INNER JOIN admin_authorities ON admins.authority_id = admin_authorities.id
